notes.title: 🖥️ Multi-Screen Support is Here!
notes.notes:
[h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45654904/7f034b56fed766f76dbb69da070f21ce5f6cfc37.png"][/img]
Hey fishers![/h1][p]You asked... we listened.
[i]Fishing Corner[/i] now supports [b]multi-monitor setups[/b]![/p][p]You can freely drag the island to [b]any screen[/b] and play from wherever feels most cozy. Whether you're working on one screen and relaxing on the other, your fisherman will be right where you want him.

⚠️ [b]If you run into any issues[/b], let us know in the Discussions tab or drop us a comment here. We’ll do our best to fix it fast!

The Happyland team[/p]

notes.title: 1000+ Wishlists in 1 day!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45654904/c1166e541a23a029ec905a3e2bd38084197e3b31.png"][/img][/p][h3]Hey everyone![/h3][p]We are a team of 2 indie game devs from Greece. Fishing Corner came from a need to slow down.
We hope it helps you do the same. 

[b]It started as a small side project.
[/b]A break from the pressure, deadlines, and stress of our usual development. We wanted to build something that felt [b]light[/b], [b]cozy[/b], and [b]kind[/b]. Something you could leave in the corner of your screen while working or relaxing, and feel a little better just knowing it’s there.
[/p][p] 🐟[b] And now… over 3000 people have played the demo![/b][b]
 [/b]🐟[b] More than 1000 of you have added it to your wishlist![/b][/p][p][b] 
We’re truly grateful![/b][/p][p]Thank you again for welcoming our little fisherman into your screen.[/p][p]More updates soon, and more fish, of course![/p][p][/p][p][i]The Happyland team[/i][/p]
